title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Car Guy. Tip #1
body: Read the number plate before you read the badge. A Corolla with a low Islamabad number and no dents belongs to a family that has had it since new. Anyone can be sitting in a Prado. Not everyone gets waved through. He knows what his plate says and so does every other driver on the Expressway. It's a sealed deal if a traffic stop has ever ended in under forty seconds without money changing hands.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 plate se pata chal jata hai.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Car Guy. Tip #2
body: Ask what he thinks of the Alto and watch the entire personality arrive. It is the most common car in this country, half of them are somebody's first, and every car guy has a prepared speech about it he is dying to deliver. Let him. The speech is the content. It's a sealed deal if he owns one, defends it on mileage, and is still slightly embarrassed.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Car Guy. Tip #3
body: Check where the car came from. Bought new from the showroom after a nine-month wait, imported used from Japan through Karachi port, or inherited from a father who maintained it better than anyone alive. Vezel, Prius, and Aqua are all the same conversation. It's a sealed deal if he can tell you the landed cost of a car he does not own, for fun.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Car Guy. Tip #4
body: Watch the tint. It is too dark, it is always too dark, and he knows exactly which roads have checkposts and which do not. There is a running negotiation between him and the state that both sides accept. It's a sealed deal if he keeps a legal set of something in the boot for exactly one week a year.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Car Guy. Tip #5
body: Ask about the wash. Not maintenance, ritual. Weekly minimum, one specific place, one specific man who does it properly, and he will not switch even after moving sectors. The car is cleaner than his room. It's a sealed deal if it has rained within an hour of a wash and he genuinely took it personally.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Car Guy. Tip #6
body: Ask what's playing and how loud. Windows down on Margalla Road at midnight is the entire point of owning it, because this city has nowhere to go and the driving is the destination. It's a sealed deal if he has a loop he drives when he's thinking, forty minutes, alone, and has never described it to anyone before you asked.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Car Guy. Tip #7
body: Look at what's parked at his father's house, because that's the real garage. The son drives the loud one. The father drives a fifteen-year-old Corolla that is immaculate and will outlive everyone. If he laughs when you ask about his dad's car, you've found the money. It's a sealed deal if the father refuses to upgrade and the whole family has stopped suggesting it.
